data.title: Artemis Drills Through Nullarbor Cover Into Sharon Dam Basement
data.description:
Artemis Resources ( (AU:ARV) ) has shared an announcement.

Artemis Resources’ maiden diamond hole at Sharon Dam has passed through the Nullarbor cover sequence and intersected interpreted Proterozoic basement at 343.3 metres below surface. Drilling was continuing in the basement at a current depth of approximately 348.8 metres.

Sharon Dam is the Madura Province’s strongest known combined magnetic and gravity anomaly, with a modelled source beginning about 400 metres below surface and extending more than 4 kilometres along strike. The target remains conceptual: its cause is unknown, and there is no certainty drilling will intersect mineralisation.

data.title: Soma Gold Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results
data.description:
Soma Gold ( (TSE:SOMA) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Soma Gold, a mining company focused on gold production and exploration in Antioquia, Colombia, reported Q3 2026 revenue of $23.8 million, up 31% from $18.1 million a year earlier; YTD revenue fell 3% to $66.7 million from $69.0 million. Income from mine operations dropped to $3.0 million from $5.3 million, and gross margin narrowed to 13% from 29%.

Adjusted EBITDA fell to $3.0 million in Q3 and $9.8 million year to date, from $6.9 million and $28.9 million, respectively. The company posted a Q3 net loss of $2.4 million, versus net income of $0.4 million, while its YTD net loss was $8.4 million versus income of $5.2 million.

Management attributed the lower margin to higher production costs as mined and milled tonnage increased to offset lower-than-expected grades at Cordero; the average realized cash margin fell to US$1,102 per ounce from US$1,676. Mill throughput rose 39% year over year, while gold grade declined to 3.98 grams per tonne from 5.75 grams per tonne, and production was 4,224 AuEq ounces versus a 7,605-ounce budget.

At September 30, Soma had $8.9 million of working capital and $0.4 million in cash, down from $17.2 million and $6.3 million at year-end 2025. Value-added tax receivables rose to $19.8 million from $12.4 million.

data.title: CF Energy Reports Third-Quarter and Nine-Month 2026 Results
data.description:
An announcement from CF Energy ( (TSE:CFY) ) is now available.

CF Energy filed unaudited results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. In Q3 2026, revenue rose 17% year over year to RMB103.5 million, while gross profit increased 13% to RMB30.9 million; net profit fell 17% to RMB3.2 million and EBITDA declined 4% to RMB22.2 million.

Q3 revenue growth was mainly attributed to higher residential gas distribution revenue and pipeline installation and connection revenue. The company also cited increased installation revenue from new Haitang Bay Smart Energy customers, while gross margin narrowed to 29.9% from 31.0% as higher material, labor and pipeline gas costs offset procurement savings and pricing changes.

For the first nine months of 2026, revenue increased 10% to RMB322.6 million, gross profit rose 12% to RMB87.2 million and net profit climbed 37% to RMB8.8 million. EBITDA decreased 1% to RMB65.5 million, while gross margin improved to 27.0% from 26.6%.

Nine-month revenue growth included the Q3 increases but was partly offset by lower EV battery swap revenue in the smart mobility segment. The company attributed that decline to tourists in Sanya City switching from taxis to rented Uber services.

data.title: Aurania Terminates Private Placement, Announces CEO Loan and Proposed Warrant Extension
data.description:
The latest update is out from Aurania Resources ( (TSE:ARU) ).

Aurania Resources is a mineral exploration company focused on identifying, evaluating, acquiring and exploring mineral properties, particularly precious metals and critical energy in Europe and abroad. The company terminated its previously announced non-brokered private placement because of current market conditions.

Chairman, President and CEO Keith Barron agreed to provide an unsecured loan of up to US$1.5 million at 2% annual interest, with advances made as agreed and repayment due 12 months and one day after demand. The proceeds are for exploration expenses and general working capital.

Aurania also applied to extend 3,747,243 warrants by 12 months, with an exercise price of C$0.75, subject to TSXV acceptance; the warrants were issued in December 2024 and otherwise retain their terms. The loan and proposed extension are related-party transactions, with exemptions from certain MI 61-101 valuation and shareholder-approval requirements; independent directors approved both.

data.title: CSN Board Elects Mario Augusto da Silva as CFO and Investor Relations Executive Officer
data.description:
Companhia Siderurgica Nacional ( (BR:CSNA3) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional (CSN) is a publicly held company. Its Board of Directors elected Mario Augusto da Silva as chief financial officer and Investor Relations Executive Officer; he will take office on December 1, 2026, succeeding interim officeholders Fabio Schvartsman and Pedro Barros Mercadante Oliva.

Silva has more than 25 years of executive, board and consulting experience, including roles as CEO of Cosan and CFO of Braskem, as well as board positions at several companies. His career includes financial and strategic transactions, along with debt and equity deals in local and international capital markets.
